5744-7507-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5744-7507-7874-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1418-2226-3634.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-3634.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

792-4210-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4210-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

512-1902-4091.easyPrerequisites: Wirewood Channeler and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-1902-4091.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
512-1902-4091.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Wirewood Channeler, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1902-4091.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Wirewood Channeler's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-2466-3249-5553.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

261-1981-2415-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2557-3129-4365-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

765-5412-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Repeat.

792-2921-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
792-2921-2946-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4289-5295.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3682-4331-5705.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
3682-4331-5705.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-3875-4231-4365-5621.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-4365-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

423-1437-1671-1993--85.easyPrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
You control nine or fewer lands.
423-1437-1671-1993--85.description:
Cast Budoka Gardener by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Budoka Gardener spell three times.
Resolve the first Budoka Gardener copy.
Activate the Budoka Gardener token by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2438-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4708-7220.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Glamermite.
When Glamermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

339-677-3967-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3532-3761-4030-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

431-1308-4772-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-4772-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

803-2034-4394-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3129-3951-4452-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3129-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1690-2364-2538-6595.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Lyse Hext.
1690-2364-2538-6595.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira and Lyse's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Jhoira trigger, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Resolve the Lyse trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {0}.
Jhoira and Lyse's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Jhoira trigger,, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Resolve the Lyse trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
1690-2364-2538-6595.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-4766-5147-5222.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender and Sword of the Realms attached to the same nontoken creature you control.
1069-4766-5147-5222.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with Sword of the Realms and Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Sword of the Realms and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {0}, attaching it to the creature that has Deathrender attached.
Repeat.

64-372-4598.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-3480-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1348-3945-4037-4641-4657.notablePrerequisites: Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
1348-3945-4037-4641-4657.description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Urza's Tower by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Urza's Tower.
Repeat from step 2.

1899-2232-2459-2600.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
1899-2232-2459-2600.description:
Activate Beastcaller Savant by tapping it, adding {G} that can only be spent to cast a creature spell.
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Beastcaller Savant by paying {G} due to Bosk Banneret.
When Beastcaller Savant enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

2571-4029-4490-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2571-4029-4490-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
If Devoted Druid has a +1/+1 counter on it, repeat from step 1 until Devoted Druid has no +1/+1 counters.
Activate Devoted Druid's outlast ability by paying {G} and tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-1627-1902-1909.notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four Elves.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Wirewood Symbiote.
1409-1627-1902-1909.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Llanowar Elves from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Wirewood Symbiote enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing it and Wirewood Symbiote.
Cast Llanowar Elves by paying {G}.
Llanowar Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, choose not to pair them together.
Repeat from step 2.

662-1102-1636-4186.notablePrerequisites: Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
662-1102-1636-4186.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Scurry Oak to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

380-1409-2972.notablePrerequisites: Ganax is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
380-1409-2972.description:
Activate Ganax by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Ganax enters the battlefield, triggering itself, any other Ganax that is on the battlefield, Miirym and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ganax.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ganax.
The Ganax token enters the battlefield, triggering itself, any other Ganax that is on the battlefield and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, choosing not to pair.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
You may also blink any other nontoken Dragon you control in place of Ganax after the first iteration by blinking Deadeye Navigator, then pairing it with any other Dragon of your choosing.

1193-3608-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {4}{B}{R}{R}{G}.
1193-3608-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything but Nyx Weaver.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna, creating token copies of each permanent besides the original target.
Activate the token copy of Nyx Weaver by paying {1}{B}{G} and exiling it, returning Radiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2, doubling the number of copies created in step 3 each repetition.

352-4276.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce {3}{U}{R}.
352-4276.description:
Cast Turnabout, choosing to untap lands.
Pay {2}{U}{R} to activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability, copying turnabout and untapping your lands.
Tap lands to produce {3}{U}{R}.
Activate Nivix and additional time and repeat the process.
